full_judgment: 8. It appears that Writ Petition No.5864 of 2000 is against the judgment and order dated 31.10.1993 passed in Case No. 14 of 1991, in this case the petitioner was not a party. Ten years after its judgment, the present petitioner wanted to be a party and to have the matter heard again on merit. But the Court of Settlement rejected the same on the ground of limitation and not being a party in the case.
